enabled.description: "Always" call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

ringReminderEnabled.description: If `true`, a brief tone will be played on the virtual line's phone when a call has been forwarded.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Enables and disables sending incoming calls to voicemail when the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

always.description: Settings for forwarding all incoming calls to the destination you choose.

enabled.description: "Busy" call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Enables and disables sending incoming to the destination number's voicemail if the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

busy.description: Settings for forwarding all incoming calls to the destination you chose while the phone is in use or the virtual line is busy.

enabled.description: "No Answer" call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

numberOfRings.description: Number of rings before the call will be forwarded if unanswered. `numberOfRings` must be between 2 and 20, inclusive.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Enables and disables sending incoming to destination number's voicemail if the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

noAnswer.description: Settings for forwarding which only occurs when you are away or not answering your phone.

callForwarding.description: Settings related to "Always", "Busy", and "No Answer" call forwarding.

enabled.description: Business Continuity is enabled or disabled.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Enables and disables sending incoming to destination number's voicemail if the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

businessContinuity.description: Settings for sending calls to a destination of your choice if your phone is not connected to the network for any reason, such as a power outage, failed Internet connection, or wiring problem.
